description: Angular component for configuring a basic action button widget in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, handling click actions, and exporting configuration data.

classes.name: ActionButtonBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent for configuring an action button widget, managing form state, and handling click actions.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group used for widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data based on form inputs.

methods.name: getOnClickAction
methods.description: Retrieves the click action from widget configuration, defaulting if not set.

methods.name: setOnClickAction
methods.description: Sets or updates the click action descriptor in widget configuration.
